title: AARO fishes for the program name and the people on it

tellings.quote: They wanted me to name the people that I knew that were working on the program. I refused to do it and they wanted the name of the program.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says he knows about a secret government UFO program, says that in 2023 AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into reports of unidentified flying objects, pressed him for details. He says from his own experience that they wanted the names of the people he knew working on the program and the name of the program itself, and that he refused to give them.
